versions.changelog: Config example now validates on OpenClaw 2026.8.1. doctor --lint replaces doctor --fix. Cron store is SQLite, jobs.json edits ignored. ownerAllowFrom vs allowFrom clarified; codex runtime posture; announce needs a deterministic filter; vm_stat and context-cost gotchas. FileVault as a trade-off with auto-login, see mac-mini.
Security hardening after ClawScan review: description declares every capability, HTTPS-only queue URL, secrets outside skill dir, dry-run purge by default, report-only watchdog, pinned install.

Add 'every does not spread a fleet - it phase-locks it' to the preflight layer: equal intervals preserve creation phase, the every fallback bypasses the dispatcher's mkdir/runningAtMs guards, and the daily restart re-anchors. Prescribes explicit cron minutes over every for heavy-job fallbacks.

1.0.0 — Initial release.

Keep an agent alive 24/7 and catch the failures that are silent by design. The gateway binds to loopback, so there is no inbound webhook — the model is an outbound poll, and that one architectural fact cascades through every integration you will try to wire.

Subscription OAuth expires in days and does not refresh headless: the daemon just starts failing every turn, quietly. The monitor here treats 'I cannot determine the expiry' as a warning, never as ok — including a credential store that parses but holds no profile, which the naive mtime proxy calls healthy for days. A monitor that says ok when it does not know manufactures silence.
